posts.title: Big changes to the Adobe Fonts website
posts.description: Last week, the Adobe Fonts website got its biggest upgrade in years: a redesigned and rebuilt font browsing experience, an AI-powered font recommendation system, and two long-requested features on the family detail pages. posts.title: Keeping type consistent in changing conditions
posts.description: At first glance, grade might seem very much like weight. But where weight serves to differentiate, grade’s purpose is to unify, allowing designers to adjust type precisely so that it appears the same across different materials, backgrounds, and lighting conditions. And once you notice the problem grade addresses, it’s hard to not see it everywhere. Continue reading this blog post on my site
